title: KAITO — Natural Juggler!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Looks like we're all here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You said that there was something you wanted to do with all of us, KAITO... But what exactly did you have in mind?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Airi gave me something very interesting.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Are you talking about the table over there with the flower-patterned wrappings?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, they're actually fortunes that Airi and the others made themselves during their stream. These are the ones that they had left over.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And there just happen to be six, so I was thinking we could put our luck to the test.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: In other words, we get to draw our fortunes here in SEKAI?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's right!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! This is great!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope I get a great blessing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As it so happens, there's a special great blessing included among these fortunes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A special great blessing?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it apparently sits a rank above your standard great blessings.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They apparently prepared two, but only drew one during their stream.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which means the person who draws the remaining one is going to have the best luck this year.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It'd certainly be nice to draw that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd also like to learn what makes it so special.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Then, let's start drawing.
Pick whichever ones you like, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin & Luka
rows.Line:
Okay.
Alright.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (These three seem reluctant to choose. But they sounded so excited just a second ago.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Ah, they must all be after the special great blessing...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (But if they don't decide soon...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, I've got it...!
The special great blessing has to be this one!

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin & Luka
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You made your choice way too fast, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm going with my instincts on this one.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Your instincts, huh...?
Then, I'll choose this one.

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin & Luka
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Now there's only four left.
What do we do...?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Luka
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's okay if you choose first, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, are you sure?
My plan was to take the last one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, since we're struggling to make our choices...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, I'll choose... This one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Huh? Was Miku thinking about taking this one? If that's the case, then I'll take this one instead...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Oh, Rin was thinking about taking this one.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(Which leaves these two...
Is Luka thinking about picking this one?
Or this one...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Ah, it's this one. Then, I'll take the other and...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Wait, both?! Wh-What's going on here?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, Luka, did you just do that on purpose?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. You caught me red-handed.
I couldn't resist since KAITO was making all these funny faces. I tried copying what Miku and Rin did just now♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: O-Oh, okay. That's what you were doing...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In that case, I'm going to choose this one and not look back.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, I've also made my choice! This one!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, I'll take this one.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Which means the last one is mine.
I'll just have to hope that it's the ticket...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now that we all have one, let's open them, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, I got a MORE MORE HAPPY☆Great Blessing. Is this...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's it, Len! You got the special great blessing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, Len, you got it!
Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait a second. If Len got it, then that means...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: By the time we began trying to figure out which one it was, it was already gone...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Y-You're right...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Now I feel kind of embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There's no need to feel embarrassed, since you put quite a lot of thought into your choice.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah!
And even my small blessing has plenty of good things to say!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I've yet to actually look at my own fortune...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (It's a great blessing...! It's not the special one, but I'm still very happy with this result.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Alright, let's see what it has to say...)
